validation_rules: the pinned Semgrep image runs through B13 with network none, a read-only target and one writable scratch mount
the repository-owned ruleset and B16 image identity are part of the input fingerprint
the caller-held B13 result sha256 is re-verified on every read
raw messages and snippets remain in the immutable tool attempt; the normalized result contains only rule ids, closed categories and fresh hashed source citations
records are static-analysis evidence leads, not verified findings, severities or observed runtime state
coverage gaps name every declared language/tool family not executed by this first happy-path slice
the node reports OK_WITH_GAPS until every declared source-SAST tool family is integrated
latest failed attempt blocks older accepted output
